description_sq:
Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar dhe ndodhet ne nje pallat te mire administruar ne nje prej zonave me te kerkuara per banim ne Tirane. Aksesi shume i mire e ben kete prone nje investim shume te mire. Apartamenti organizohet nga nje dhome ngrenje dhe ndenje bashke, nje dhome gjumi dhe nje tualet. Eshte i shtruar me parket dhe ka orientim nga lindja. Banesa ka punime shume cilesore teksa eshte e arreduar ne menyre bashkekohore. Gjithashtu disponon dokumenta te rregullta pronesie. 
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni!
description_en: The apartment is fully furnished and is located in a well-managed building in one of the most sought-after residential areas in Tirana. Very good access makes this property a very good investment. The apartment is organized by a common dining room and living room, a bedroom and a bathroom. It is paved with parquet and has an east orientation. The apartment has very high-quality works as it is furnished in a contemporary way. It also has regular ownership documents. For more information contact us!
